summary: EDAP TMS SA filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing a corporate name change to FocalTherics and a new ticker symbol FOCL on Nasdaq, effective June 1, 2026. The legal name remains unchanged pending shareholder approval. The company also intends to report its ESWL and Distribution segments as discontinued operations starting Q2 2026. No deal terms, premium, or advisor mentioned. This is a routine branding and segment reclassification event, not a special-situation transaction. What to watch: shareholder vote on legal name change and investor day presentation on June 1.
